# Subclass 309 Grant Horizon — Swiss Cheese AI

Canonical URL: https://visa.swisscheeseai.au/
Owner: Swiss Cheese AI

This web calculator estimates a likely decision window for an Australian Partner (Provisional) visa, subclass 309, from processing-time benchmark inputs using a statistical scenario model.

Important limitations:
- This is not an official Australian Department of Home Affairs tool.
- It cannot see an applicant's case, officer, checks or queue position.
- Results are estimates and should not be treated as a guaranteed grant or decision date.

Primary source: https://visa.swisscheeseai.au/
